2. 132 BPM – ARRIVED. The tempo sounds steady and close to 132 BPM throughout.  
3. D minor – PARTIAL. The tonality seems minor and moody, but I cannot confirm it’s precisely D minor by ear.  
4. Never lifting into anthem – ARRIVED. The track stays subdued and does not lift into an anthemic chorus or big musical swell.  
5. Opens on a chair leg dragged on wet concrete – ABSENT. The intro is instrumental without the sound of a chair leg dragging.  
6. Then a dry down-stroke on steel-string acoustic through a small overdriven amp, strings buzzing, hard left – ABSENT. The acoustic guitar is present but not obviously overdriven, buzzing, or hard-left. It seems more centered or balanced.  
7. Female alto, plain regional English, unimpressed, no vibrato, audible breath, dead centre two inches off the capsule – ARRIVED. The vocal is female, in an alto range, plain and unimpressed, with little vibrato, audible breath, and centered.  
8. A snarl withheld to one word at the end – PARTIAL. The vocal delivery remains mostly flat; there is some emphasis near the end, but not a pronounced snarl on a specific word.  
9. Floor tom only, mono, right of centre, no cymbals, close-mic’d in a small tiled room – ABSENT. The percussion includes more than just a floor tom, and it isn’t isolated right of centre or obviously close-mic’d in a tiled room.  
10. A strip-light mains hum sits hard right, tuned, dead steady on one pitch – ABSENT. I didn’t detect a mains hum in the right channel.  
11. The drive-motor whine far back runs a quarter-tone flat of it; nothing corrects either – ABSENT. I didn’t hear a distinct drive-motor whine quarter-tone flat.  
12. Verses stay level – ARRIVED. The verses remain consistent in dynamics and delivery.  
13. The middle stops mid-strum; four seconds pass with nothing but the two drones – ABSENT. The track doesn’t have a mid-song break with only drones for four seconds.  
14. The restart is later and flatter – ABSENT. There’s no noticeable restart with a flatter feel after a break.  
15. Nothing slows for the unrhymed section’s last line – ARRIVED. The unrhymed section doesn’t slow down; the tempo remains consistent.  
16. Final chorus enters a bar early, tom wrong and left wrong – ABSENT. The final chorus seems to enter on time; tom placement remains consistent.  
17. Bold device: the take gives up and begins again – ABSENT. The track plays continuously without giving up and restarting mid-take.

Not asked for but better than specified: The production is clean and well-balanced, which adds clarity and accessibility, though this deviates from the requested raw aesthetic.
